## Arc SQL Server License Compliance

Monitors SQL Server license compliance across Arc-enabled servers. Displays which instances are using the correct license type and which require remediation.

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| extend licenseType = tostring(properties.licenseType)
| extend version = tostring(properties.version)
| extend edition = tostring(properties.edition)
| extend sqlStatus = tostring(properties.status)
| extend instanceName = tostring(properties.instanceName)
| extend containerResourceId = tostring(properties.containerResourceId)
| extend machineName = tostring(split(containerResourceId, '/')[8])
| where instanceName !contains "SSIS" 
    and instanceName !contains "SSRS" 
    and instanceName !contains "SSAS"
    and instanceName !contains "PBIRS"
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines"
    | extend machineStatus = tostring(properties.status)
    | extend machineName = name
    | project machineName, machineStatus, machineId = id
) on machineName
| summarize 
    licenseType = any(licenseType),
    version = any(version),
    edition = any(edition),
    sqlStatus = any(sqlStatus),
    machineStatus = any(machineStatus),
    resourceGroup = any(resourceGroup),
    location = any(location),
    instanceName = any(instanceName)
    by machineName
| where isnotempty(machineStatus)
| extend compliant = (licenseType == "{TargetLicenseType}")
| extend isOnline = (machineStatus == "Connected" and sqlStatus == "Connected")
| where "{ShowOffline}" == "Yes" or isOnline == true
| summarize 
    TotalInstances = count(),
    OnlineInstances = countif(isOnline == true),
    OfflineInstances = countif(isOnline == false),
    CompliantOnline = countif(isOnline == true and compliant == true),
    NonCompliantOnline = countif(isOnline == true and compliant == false)

    | extend machineStatus = tostring(properties.status)

| extend compliant = (licenseType == "{TargetLicenseType}")
| extend isOnline = (machineStatus == "Connected" and sqlStatus == "Connected")
